newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA 1996 SUGAR OUTPUT FALLS 64 PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA 1996 SUGAR OUTPUT FALLS 64 PERCENT.

text.p: Bulgaria processed 53,000 tonnes of sugar beet this year, producing 5,300 tonnes of white sugar, Botyo Mitev, head of the Sugar Institute, said on Friday.
The figures were far below 1995's production of 14,765 tonnes of sugar from 147,000 tonnes of beet. Mitev said output had turned out even lower than forecast at the start of the season.
Because of a shortage of animal feed, some farmers had fed sugar beet to their animals rather than selling it to Bulgaria's two sugar producing companies, he said.

Mitev said in October that this year's beet area had been reduced to 6,000 hectares from 11,200 ha last year and farmers were having trouble obtaining funds due to the general economic crisis in the country.
